name: sober-tv
description: Sober TV — 高端简约的 Android 影视聚合客户端

scripts.sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.apk:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:split: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && node scripts/split-apk.mjs
